meta.title: Insurance Technology Insights | Iorta TechNXT
meta.description: Explore Iorta TechNXT perspectives on core modernization, distribution, claims, data, automation, Takaful and Southeast Asian insurance technology.

hero.title: Ideas for what's next in insurance.
hero.lede: Perspectives on the technology, operating models and market shifts changing how insurance is distributed, serviced and managed.

groups.title: The perspectives we are writing next.
body: Articles are published as they clear review. Each will connect to a related solution, product and customer proof rather than ending as a market summary.

items.title: Why Core Modernization Doesn't Always Start With Replacement
items.summary: How progressive modernization can reduce constraints without forcing a high-risk full-platform program.

items.title: The Next Phase of Insurance Distribution
items.summary: Why direct, advisor, broker, bank and partner channels need to work together rather than compete for ownership of the customer.

items.title: From Self-Service to Proactive Policyholder Service
items.summary: How digital service can move from access to timely action.

items.title: What Human-Governed Insurance Automation Looks Like
items.summary: Where automation creates value, where judgement remains essential and how operational controls fit between the two.

items.title: From Claims Processing to Claims Orchestration
items.summary: How structured intake, triage, work management and communication can improve the claims operating model.

items.title: Open Finance and the Future of Connected Insurance
items.summary: What consent-driven data exchange could mean for banking, insurance and partner distribution.

items.title: Designing Insurance Technology Across Southeast Asian Markets
items.summary: Why regional scale still requires local flexibility in workflows, distribution and integration.

groups.title: Thought leadership should support a decision.
body: Every article answers two questions: what is changing in insurance, and what should an insurer do differently because of it.
Each one connects onward to a related solution, product, customer proof and an appropriate next step: explore a related article or story, evaluate product features and architecture, or talk to us.

groups.title: Where automation creates value, and where AI adds something beyond workflow.
body: This stream explains where automation creates value in insurance, and where AI genuinely adds something beyond workflow: measurement, accountability, document understanding, decision support and the control model around them.

body: News items are published from the content system rather than maintained by hand, so an announcement never lingers here after it is superseded. Each will carry its category, date, headline and a short summary.

groups.title: No events currently scheduled.
body: Conferences, roundtables, webinars, speaking engagements and past appearances will be listed here. Each will show the date, city or virtual format, the event name and how Iorta is participating.
Nothing is listed in advance of confirmation: an event that quietly disappears costs more trust than one announced late.
